prefix.description: The installation prefix directory for Heimdal libraries, used for --prefix option.

exec_prefix.description: The execution prefix directory for Heimdal binaries/libraries, used for --exec-prefix option.

libs.description: List of Heimdal libraries to request flags for. Supported values: krb5, gssapi, kadm-client, kadm-server.

cflags.description: If true, output C compiler flags (--cflags).

link_libs.description: If true, output linker library flags (--libs).
